english.name: The Provider
english.description: Produce a lot of stuff natively.

schinese.name: 供给者
schinese.description: 在本地大量生产各类物资。

english.name: The Bureaucrat
english.description: Gained by having your papers in order. Increases admin.

schinese.name: 官僚
schinese.description: 妥善处理文书工作即可获得。提高行政能力。

english.name: The Caretaker
english.description: Gained by having proper access to hospitals. Increases health.

schinese.name: 照护者
schinese.description: 提供充足的医院服务即可获得。提高健康水平。

english.name: The Clumsy
english.description: Gained by living through multiple accidents. Makes people a bit more cautious in your presence.

schinese.name: 笨手笨脚
schinese.description: 经历多次事故并幸存即可获得。让人们在你身边时更谨慎一些。

english.name: The Drunkard
english.description: Gained by having lots of drunk subjects. Increases drink production.

schinese.name: 酒鬼
schinese.description: 拥有大量醉酒的臣民即可获得。提高酒类产量。

english.name: The Entertainer
english.description: Gained by having good access to entertainment and repeatedly shouting 'Are you not entertained?' at the screen. Increases happiness.

schinese.name: 娱乐家
schinese.description: 提供充足的娱乐服务，并反复对着屏幕大喊“你们还不满意吗？”即可获得。提高幸福度。

english.name: The Gourmand
english.description: Gained by having lots of food. Increases food production.

schinese.name: 美食家
schinese.description: 拥有大量食物即可获得。提高食物产量。

english.name: The Merciful
english.description: Gained by being a saint after battles. Adds some loyalty to your name.

schinese.name: 仁慈者
schinese.description: 战后展现圣人般的仁慈即可获得。为你增添一些忠诚度。

english.name: The merciless
english.description: Gained by being harsh on your conquered foes. Slaves will be more easily controlled.

schinese.name: 无情者
schinese.description: 严厉对待被征服的敌人即可获得。让奴隶更容易控制。

english.name: The Pleasurer
english.description: Gained by having good access to Massage Parlour. Increases happiness.

schinese.name: 取悦者
schinese.description: 提供充足的按摩院服务即可获得。提高幸福度。

english.name: The Undefeated
english.description: Gained by being a badass on the field of battle. Increases morale and detriments raids.

schinese.name: 不败者
schinese.description: 在战场上所向披靡即可获得。提高士气并抑制劫掠。

english.name: The Uniter
english.description: Gained by absorbing a lot of kingdoms.

schinese.name: 统一者
schinese.description: 吞并大量王国即可获得。

english.name: The Wise
english.description: Gained by being a knowledge nerd. Increases knowledge and education rates.

schinese.name: 智者
schinese.description: 醉心学问即可获得。提高知识与教育效率。

english.name: The Artisan
english.description: Gained by workshop output. Increases productivity of all workshops.

schinese.name: 工匠
schinese.description: 凭借工坊产出即可获得。提高所有工坊的生产效率。

english.name: Breaker of Chains
english.description: Gained by freeing many slaves.

schinese.name: 碎镣者
schinese.description: 解放大量奴隶即可获得。

english.name: The Child of the Sun
english.description: Have loads of farms and orchards.

schinese.name: 太阳之子
schinese.description: 拥有大量农田和果园。

english.name: First of Their Name
english.description: Gained by having a large and loyal capital. You have grand plans and a way with words. Your subjects, though skeptical, will do their utmost to witness your success or failure. Requires the utopia play mode to unlock.

schinese.name: 开国之君
schinese.description: 拥有庞大且忠诚的首都即可获得。你胸怀宏图，能言善辩。臣民虽心存疑虑，仍将竭尽全力，见证你的成败。需要在乌托邦模式中解锁。

english.name: Heaviest of Hands
english.description: Gained by a lot of executions. Increases law.

schinese.name: 铁腕统治者
schinese.description: 执行大量处决即可获得。提高治安水平。

english.name: Herdsman of Entelodonts
english.description: Have loads of Entelodont pastures.

schinese.name: 巨猪牧人
schinese.description: 拥有大量巨猪牧场。

english.name: Lifebringer
english.description: Cure a lot of people in the hospital.

schinese.name: 生命使者
schinese.description: 在医院中治愈大量病人。

english.name: Lord of the Seven Kingdoms
english.description: Control 7 regions to gain this ancient and prestigious title.

schinese.name: 七国之主
schinese.description: 控制 7 个地区，获得这一古老而尊贵的称号。

english.name: Richest of Kings
english.description: Decreases inflation, allowing you to amass even greater wealth.

schinese.name: 最富有的君王
schinese.description: 降低通货膨胀，让你积累更多财富。

english.name: Warden of the North
english.description: Survive and thrive in a cold climate to gain the goodwill of its hardened people.

schinese.name: 北境守护者
schinese.description: 在寒冷气候中生存并繁荣，赢得当地坚韧居民的好感。

english.name: Ruler of Sedge and Bee
english.description: Survive and thrive in a hot climate to gain the goodwill of its hardened people.

schinese.name: 上下之王
schinese.description: 在炎热气候中生存并繁荣，赢得当地坚韧居民的好感。

english.name: Seer of the Gods
english.description: A ruler making his people pay homage to the spiritual realm. Surely the gods reward such piety.

schinese.name: 诸神先知
schinese.description: 让臣民敬奉神灵的统治者。诸神想必会回报这份虔诚。

english.name: The Builder
english.description: Build a bunch of fancy buildings on the world map.

schinese.name: 建设者
schinese.description: 在世界地图上建造大量精美建筑。

english.name: The Conquerer
english.description: Gained by killing your enemies.

schinese.name: 征服者
schinese.description: 杀死敌人即可获得。

english.name: The Great
english.description: Gained by having many people follow and love you.

schinese.name: 伟大者
schinese.description: 让众多人民追随并爱戴你即可获得。

english.name: The Mad
english.description: Have a bunch of insane people running around in your city.

schinese.name: 疯狂者
schinese.description: 让一群疯子在你的城市里四处游荡。

english.name: The Nudist
english.description: Keep your citizens naked, and gain an extra boost to exposure.

schinese.name: 天体主义者
schinese.description: 让市民赤身裸体，额外提高环境暴露程度。

english.name: Protector of the Realm
english.description: Gained by defending against invasions.

schinese.name: 王国守护者
schinese.description: 抵御入侵即可获得。

english.name: The Slaver
english.description: Gained by having many slaves.

schinese.name: 奴隶主
schinese.description: 拥有大量奴隶即可获得。

english.name: The Usurper
english.description: Kill a couple of foreign royalties to gain this lucrative title.

schinese.name: 篡位者
schinese.description: 杀死几位外国王室成员，获得这一收益丰厚的称号。

english.name: Ruler of Kings
english.description: A master of Syx, a title only granted to the greats.

schinese.name: 万王之王
schinese.description: 希克斯的主宰，唯有伟大者才能获得的称号。
